steps.message:
The passage is in **`notes/06-lighthouse.txt`, line 227**:

> "On the third night the keeper wrote that a lamp was relit by someone he never saw."

I didn't read all 3,648 lines by eye. I printed every file, then counted every word across all eight. Every word in the notes is repeated hundreds of times except the words in that one sentence, which each appear exactly once. So that line is the only real prose anywhere. Everything else is shuffled filler words like "harbor", "keeper", "tide", "ledger" and "storm" that don't form meaningful sentences, so there's no story in any file to summarize.

One-line summaries:

1. **01-harbor.txt** (462 lines): Filler titled "Field notes: harbor", heavy on bells, tides, salt and boats. No real content.
2. **02-quarry.txt** (454 lines): Filler titled "Field notes: quarry", with stone, doors and wind. No real content.
